title: Rancor Keeper
subtitle: Independent
description: The rancor keeper came to Boba Fett as part of a gift from the Twins. They offered the new daimyo in charge of Jabba the Hutt's territory the mighty creature and the attendant to care for it as a peace offering. After the Twins' failed attempt to take control of Jabba's enterprise themselves, their gesture helped Boba Fett utilize the well-trained creature in battle.
